chunks: Eat and drink, and be at peace. If you see any man, tell him: 'I have verily vowed a fast to Ar-Rahman and cannot speak to any one this day.'

key_terms.قَرِّي عَيْنًا: be at peace / comfort the eye

ai.seo_question: What did Maryam say when people questioned her about Jesus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition of Maryam from a state of spiritual isolation to social reintegration, where her vow of silence (samt) serves as a dignified shield against public scrutiny rather than a permanent ascetic practice. The command to eat and drink signifies the restoration of her physical strength and divine favor following the miraculous birth, emphasizing that divine support includes worldly comfort. This moment underscores her unique status as a purified woman (Muqaddasa) whose silence protects the mystery of Isa's birth until the appointed time.
